verdicts.rationale: Confirmed type coercion defect: POST /schema with vectorIndexConfig.distance=null returns HTTP 200 with distance coerced to 'cosine'. Source code analysis (entities/vectorindex/hnsw/config.go + common/config.go) reveals root cause: OptionalStringFromMap function performs silent type assertion that fails for null values, causing fallback to default instead of validation error or null preservation. This violates physical constraint (distance must be valid string enum, not null) and is not graceful/by-design. Falls under developer-recognized bug pattern BS-004 (Parameter Validation Issues). Independent GET verification confirms coercion is persisted to storage. High severity: affects core schema API, could lead to unexpected index behavior if user relies on explicit null handling.
